+def test_build_and_install_symlinks(collection_input, tmp_path_factory):
+    input_dir, output_dir = collection_input
+    os.symlink(os.path.join(input_dir, 'README.md'), os.path.join(input_dir, 'docs', 'internal.md'))
+    os.symlink(os.path.join(input_dir, 'roles'), os.path.join(input_dir, 'linked_roles'))
+
+    outside = to_text(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('outside'))
+    outside_file = os.path.join(outside, 'external.md')
+    with open(outside_file, 'wb') as file_obj:
+        file_obj.write(b'external content')
+    os.symlink(outside_file, os.path.join(input_dir, 'docs', 'external.md'))
+
+    collection.build_collection(input_dir, output_dir, False)
+    artifact = os.path.join(output_dir, 'ansible_namespace-collection-0.1.0.tar.gz')
+    with tarfile.open(artifact) as tar:
+        assert tar.getmember('docs/internal.md').issym()
+        assert tar.getmember('linked_roles').issym()
+        assert tar.getmember('docs/external.md').isreg()
+        assert tar.extractfile('docs/external.md').read() == b'external content'
+
+    namespace = to_bytes(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('installed'))
+    destination = os.path.join(namespace, b'collection')
+    requirement = collection.CollectionRequirement.from_tar(to_bytes(artifact), False)
+    requirement.install_artifact(destination, namespace)
+    assert os.path.islink(os.path.join(destination, b'docs', b'internal.md'))
+    assert os.readlink(os.path.join(destination, b'docs', b'internal.md')) == b'../README.md'
+    assert os.path.islink(os.path.join(destination, b'linked_roles'))
+    assert not os.path.islink(os.path.join(destination, b'docs', b'external.md'))
+    with open(os.path.join(destination, b'docs', b'external.md'), 'rb') as file_obj:
+        assert file_obj.read() == b'external content'
+
